name: AI Module - Checklist Generation & RAG Assistant
description: AI subsystem: provider abstraction (OpenRouter/OpenAI/Anthropic/local), Phase 1 checklist generation with JSON schema validation, Phase 2 RAG manual assistant with pgvector embeddings, usage tracking and rate limiting.

core.ModuleBase: Both AIModule and FilesModule implement name, version, dependencies, profiles, configure/initialize/start/stop/health lifecycle
core.event_bus: Publishes ai.* and file.* events, subscribes to manual.ingestion_requested
core.logger: Structured JSON logging with module namespacing
core.utils: utcnow(), new_id() for timestamps and IDs

db.org_scoped_session: All queries filtered by organization_id with RLS
db.pgvector: Ready for embedding storage and similarity search

api.RequestContext: Extracts org_id, user_id, role from claims

auth.require_roles: MANAGER/SYS_ADMIN for AI generation, MANAGER/MAINTENANCE for ingestion

storage.put/get/delete/presigned_url: Used by FILES module for blob operations

privacy.sanitize_prompt: Strips UUIDs, emails, org identifiers before external API calls

checklist_generation.retry_logic: Up to 3 retries on invalid JSON

rag_assistant.filtering: org_id + node_id scope for multi-tenant isolation
rag_assistant.fallback: 'I could not find this information in the manuals'

file_validation.dual_check: BOTH extension AND MIME type validated

ingestion_pipeline.chunking: With metadata: {org_id, file_id, page, chunk_index, heading, tokens}

env_vars.CMMS_AI__PRIVACY_MODE_ORGS: Comma-separated org IDs forced to local adapter

restrictions: AI module never stores raw prompts containing PII
External providers only receive sanitized prompts
PRIVACY_MODE_ORGS force local adapter regardless of config
Checklist generation requires MANAGER or SYS_ADMIN role
Manual ingestion limited to PDF/TXT/DOCX formats
File uploads require BOTH valid extension AND matching MIME
Executable files always blocked regardless of extension
All operations org-scoped with RLS enforcement
Usage logged for every AI operation

Implement full SQLAlchemy ORM models for all tables with proper relationships
Add telemetry/metrics for AI latency, token usage, failure rates

Consider adding streaming SSE support for assistant responses

Add org-level AI usage quotas with hard limits
Consider caching frequently accessed document chunks
Implement advanced text extraction for PDF (layout preservation)
Add support for additional embedding dimensions based on model
notes: Module follows DDD patterns established in previous chunks
Event-driven architecture: AI consumes manual.ingestion_requested, emits ai.* events
FILES module provides critical infrastructure for AI RAG pipeline
Placeholder implementations ready for production HTTP client integration
All API routes properly secured with RBAC guards
Beat schedules registered for failed ingestion retry
Privacy-first design: PII stripped before external API calls
Dual validation (extension + MIME) prevents file type spoofing attacks

dependencies_chain.chunk_1: core (ModuleBase, event bus, registry, logger, utils)
dependencies_chain.chunk_2: db (AsyncSession, pgvector), cache (rate limiting), storage (blob ops)
